notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three: three short pages, no dates for building or removal, no staffing, no photos. The firelookout.com line '1930s: history unknown. Abandoned.' does not say whether the decade is the build or the abandonment, so the story says so. The FFLA list coordinates are 48.00000 -113.14046; the latitude is a round number and may be approximate, so check the location before relying on it. The story is about 123 words after this check's wording fixes, so it meets the 120-word guide floor; the sources give no more, and it was not padded. Not checked: 1930s newspapers and Flathead NF history reports, which could date the lookout.
